item.title: How to convert radians to degrees in JavaScript
item.description: Converting radians to degrees is essential for displaying trigonometric results, rotation controls, compass displays, and geometric utilities in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used this conversion in rotation sliders, angle indicators, and chart label formatting. JavaScript’s Math.atan2(), Math.asin(), and Math.acos() return radians — convert to degrees before displaying to users. For the inverse operation, see how to convert degrees to radians in JavaScript.

item.title: How to convert degrees to radians in JavaScript
item.description: Converting degrees to radians is essential for trigonometric functions, canvas graphics, SVG animations, and geometric transformations in JavaScript applications. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used this conversion in chart rotations, animation systems, and canvas-based components. JavaScript’s Math.sin(), Math.cos(), and Math.tan() all expect radian values — degrees must be converted before use. For the inverse operation, see how to convert radians to degrees in JavaScript.
